hero: Hi, I’m Landon — Software Engineer & Language Learner.
about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a 4th year computer science student at the University of Windsor, passionate about software engineering and language learning. I learn Japanese through immersion, mainly by reading manga and watching anime. Engaging with native materials daily helps me improve my language skills naturally. I enjoy building web applications, exploring new technologies, and collaborating on innovative projects. I'm always eager to learn, grow, and take on new challenges. In my spare time I immerse myself in Japanese by watchig anime and reading manga. My hopes are to be a JET program teacher for the 2026 cohort to teach english abroad in Japan!
experience.title: Experience

bullets: Rewrote mobile/web app from Angular/Ionic into React/Next.js + Typescript, improving bundle performance by 25%, improved backend scalability with transaction logging, session checks and secure DB access controls.

Designed & deployed ERC-20 YAP token on Sei Testnet using Ethers.js including writing, testing, and verifying smart contracts. Built on-chain paywalls via an ERC-20 transfer call gated through Postgres.

Dockerized dev environments and configured AWS deployments for both frontend and backend services. Led CI/CD & code quality assurance by authoring GitHub action pipelines, enforcing linting/testing, and ran code reviews
Evaluating open-source algorithms for extracting slide labels and handwriting from pathology slides
Creating workflows for accurate extraction of text and labels from pathology slides using Python
Tuning object detection models for improved performance on handwriting and label recognition
Designing and implementing a robust pipeline to automate the extraction, preprocessing, and model training processes, ensuring scalability and consistency across tasks
Redesigned and rebuilt the club’s website from scratch using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, resulting in a modern, responsive, and maintainable platform
Implemented best practices for accessibility, SEO, and performance optimization, significantly improving user experience and site discoverability
Collaborated with team members to gather requirements, iterate on UI/UX designs, and deploy updates efficiently
Migrated the organization’s website from Wix to React, modernizing the interface and improving performance
Building a comprehensive hub that serves as a centralized portal for all applications developed by the club
Developed a React frontend with a graph to visualize risk and return trade-offs based on ticket weights
